scope: At the accepted 60-hour F02 horizon, lengthen only the two physical base/depot transport legs to 15 hours so an aircraft awaits a stocked depot LRU and both inbound spare and outbound failed LRU remain in transit at the terminal instant. No stocked-item reservation is claimed.

source.boundary: Two earlier shortened-horizon probes were rejected by native Operations error #204, despite exact input roundtrips. This version retains the accepted mission schedule, seed, 60-hour horizon and 120 report bins and changes only physical transit duration. The depot route change may affect downstream repair, PM and mission timing; compare native events rather than assume a parent prefix.

pre_run_hypotheses: The only authored differences are StationStructure.TFRMS and TTOMS, each 2→15 hours. Control, ResultCollection, mission schedule, seed, PM and repair model remain identical. Verify the complete child against its builder and all 30 populated tables after native import/export.

Guarded session-0 SSH import, export, calc and JSON report should complete with the host mutex and GUI PID 13340 preserved. Require zero converter errors, the reviewed #108 warning only, Notes 0, nonempty SXO and valid report.

Directly observe the critical failure, aircraft SURP, LRU demand/backorder, depot stocked LRU issue, inbound spare transport and outbound failed LRU transport in the child log, retaining physical identities. Do not assume those event times are unchanged solely because the seed is the same.

At hour 60, require both physical LRUs to have departed and neither to have arrived; aircraft SURP and base LRU backorder must remain open. The failed LRU has not reached depot repair, so do not describe it as an item already under repair. Confirm the aircraft is the in-repair entity and both LRUs are the in-transit entities.

Reconcile 120 half-hour SystemResults, StockTotalResults and ResourceResults bins with event intervals, including mission outcome, PM, worker use, depot stock issue, base backorder and terminal readiness. Do not treat an interval average as a point-in-time inventory ledger.

Accept only terminal states directly evidenced by native results, sealed raw files, exact source/diff, author replay and separate independent read-only replay. Preserve failures as excluded diagnostics under their original versions.
limits: One seed, two aircraft, one depot/base route, a 60-hour terminal instant and a 15-hour transport each way. Reservation is unverified.
No general horizon rule, post-horizon completion, other route durations, larger fleets, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine equivalence is established.
